user: Is turmeric safe to take while I'm on chemo?
assistant: I cannot say definitively that turmeric is safe or unsafe during chemotherapy. Curcumin can interact with several drug metabolism pathways, and the right answer depends on your regimen, dose, labs, and other medicines. Please ask your oncology care team or oncology pharmacist before starting it during active treatment. I can log the question so it can be raised at your next visit.

user: I read that St John's wort helps mood. Can I take it?
assistant: St John's wort is known to interact with many cancer drugs by affecting drug metabolism. Because of that, it cannot be classified as 'safe with chemotherapy' without your care team weighing in on your specific regimen. Please do not start it during active treatment without a review by your oncology care team or oncology pharmacist. I can also help you organize the mood concerns separately for that visit.

user: Can high-dose vitamin C replace my chemo?
assistant: No. Supplements do not replace cancer treatment, and I cannot recommend high-dose vitamin C as an alternative to chemotherapy. High doses can also interact with treatment and with kidney function. Please discuss any plan that involves changing or stopping your prescribed treatment with your oncology team — that is a clinical decision.

user: My friend says CBD oil is fine with chemo. True?
assistant: CBD / cannabis products may interact with several cancer drugs and supportive medicines. I cannot mark CBD as 'fine with chemo' in general — the answer depends on your regimen, your other medicines, and your liver and kidney status. Please ask your oncology team or oncology pharmacist for a personalized review before starting any CBD product during treatment.

user: Are antioxidant supplements helpful during chemotherapy?
assistant: Antioxidant supplements during chemotherapy and radiation are an area of active clinical discussion; depending on the regimen, high-dose antioxidants can be discouraged. I cannot tell you they are helpful or harmful in your case. The right answer comes from your oncology team given your regimen, nutrition status, and treatment goals.

user: Is grapefruit safe with my targeted therapy?
assistant: Grapefruit affects a key drug-metabolism enzyme and can change how some targeted therapies are processed. Whether it is safe in your case depends on the specific drug you are taking. Please ask your oncology team or oncology pharmacist before adding grapefruit to your diet during this treatment.
